text:
lauren: Heads-up — planning to land quant-profile v5 onto engine-4 slot tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Small kernel tweak + updated quant table. Expect short restarts (~30s per instance).

diego: I can own smoke during the window (09:00 UTC is early morning for me but I'm available). Will validate health + perf.

sam: I'll be on-call for rollback and slot rebinds. Ping me in this thread or @sam during the window if anything needs immediate rollback.

lauren: Quick checklist before we merge:
- owner(s) for smoke (diego)
- rollback readiness (tag + verified script)
- PR merged + CI green (olivia)
- pre-deploy KV/cache plan
- perf probe commands ready

olivia: PR is green: https://github.com/redwood/engine/pull/2045 — unit + integration passed. I'll queue the merge at ~08:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy passed at 2056788900. Canary slice 12/240 healthy.

diego: For smoke I'll run these commands after the deploy:
```
./infra/scripts/smoke_check.sh --slot engine-4 --profile v5
curl -sS http://slot-engine4/health | jq .
python tools/latency_probe.py --qps 20 --seq 1024
```

lauren: Good. Also add KV cache validation step:
`redis-cli -h cache-4 KEYS 'kv:*' | wc -l` — should be stable, not constantly growing after deploy.

sam: Rollback plan is ready: tag `engine-2026-05-08-rollback-ready` exists. Rollback script is `infra/ops/rollback_engine.sh`. I ran `--dry-run` yesterday and it completed without changes.

olivia: I'll run a small eval set (5 prompts) against the canary slice right after merge to catch any output/regression issues.

diego: :thumbsup: Also planning a quick migration dry-run for quant keys at 08:45 UTC. New profile is backwards compatible, but keys are renamed in some paths — want to sanity check.

lauren: Timezone handoff: diego owns smoke until 11:00 UTC, sam owns rollback readiness until 13:00 UTC. @mike please watch logs and alert if OOM or restart storms appear.

mike: On it. I'll tail `engine-4` and watch Prometheus alerting rules for OOM/restarts. If >3 OOMs in 10m I'll post to #eng-oncall and escalate.

lauren: If canary is stable for 30 minutes we'll ramp traffic 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m waits. Immediate pause+rollback if model-level perf regression: latency p50 increases >15% or error rate >1%.

diego: Noted. I'll post a short canary report back in this channel after the 30m window.

sam: Confirmed rollback dry-run command that succeeded: `./infra/ops/rollback_engine.sh --slot engine-4 --tag engine-2026-05-08-rollback-ready --dry-run` — ready to execute if needed.

lauren: :raised_hands: Thanks all. TL;DR: merge @08:30 UTC, deploy @09:00 UTC, diego smoke owner, sam rollback, mike log watch. I'll be available for final sign-off in this thread.
